title: 第一卷 第19章 未来的路一个人走也无妨第一卷 第20章 和凌玄道的初次见面
content_zh:
翌日，林罪和往常一样，早早起床，然后去叫醒还在打呼噜的李群书。
李群书伸了伸懒腰，揉了揉眼睛，“罪哥，你咋天天都能这么准时”。
林罪笑而不语，前世他就是这样，从不需要闹钟，到时间自然而然就会醒。
两人去屋外胡乱擦了把脸，水还是那么凉，泼在脸上激得人一哆嗦。
李群书被凉水激得嗷了一声，然后嘿嘿笑起来，“这水真凉。”
林罪点点头，“说不定要下雨了。”
……
洗漱完，两人扛着扫帚出了门。
清晨的山道上雾气还没散尽，看向远处，房屋，长生宗建筑，山峰若隐若现。
林罪有些感慨，要是放在前世，就这种景色，绝对是最顶尖的风景区。
两人今天扫的台阶是西山石阶，两旁种满许多金杏，金杏的叶子上挂着一层薄薄的黄色油脂，太阳一出，反着光，就像黄金一样。
金杏叶上挂着露珠，风一吹簌簌地往下落。
两人从最下面的台阶开始扫。
李群书扫左边，林罪扫右边，扫帚划过石面发出沙沙的声响。
扫到一半的时候，李群书拄着扫帚柄，回头看了林罪一眼，“罪哥。”
“嗯？”
“没什么”，他又转过头去，继续扫。
林罪看着他的背影，也没追问。
……
外门，一处偏院。

祁云站在院门口，两只手垂在身侧，身体微微弓着。
他今天换了身干净的外门弟子服，头发也重新束过。
脸上挂着笑，皮笑肉不笑的具象。
他在门口站了大概一柱香的工夫，屋内才传来一道声音。
“进来。”
祁云推开门，脸上的笑容瞬间变得极尽谄媚。
楚雄歪在椅子上，一只脚搭在茶台上，一个面容巧丽，身材丰满的女子给他按摩。
具体按摩哪里……（懂的面壁思过一下，不懂的假装一下）
“楚师兄，”祁云弯着腰，“您上次说的那件事，我觉得……”
“我让你说话了？”
祁云的笑僵在脸上，然后立刻闭了嘴，腰弯得更低。
楚雄抖擞了一会，语气不咸不淡的说道。
content_en:
The next day, Lin Zui got up early as usual, and then went to wake up Li Qunshu, who was still snoring.
Li Qunshu stretched and rubbed his eyes, "Brother Zui, how come you are so punctual every day?"
Lin Zui smiled and said nothing. He was like this in his previous life. He never needed an alarm clock and would wake up naturally when the time came.
The two of them went outside the house and wiped their faces randomly. The water was still so cold that it made them shiver when it was splashed on their faces.
Li Qunshu screamed at the cold water, and then laughed, "This water is really cold."
Lin Zui nodded, "Maybe it's going to rain."
…
After washing, the two of them walked out the door carrying brooms.
The fog has not cleared up on the mountain road in the early morning. Looking into the distance, there are houses, the buildings of the Changsheng Sect, and the mountain peaks are looming.
Lin Zui felt a little emotional. In his previous life, this kind of scenery would definitely be the top scenic spot.
The steps the two of them were sweeping today were stone steps from the West Mountain. Many golden apricots were planted on both sides. The leaves of the golden apricots were covered with a thin layer of yellow oil. When the sun came out, they reflected the light, just like gold.
Dewdrops hang on the golden apricot leaves, falling rustlingly when the wind blows.
The two started sweeping from the bottom step.
Li Qunshu swept to the left and Lin Zui swept to the right. The broom made a rustling sound across the stone surface.
Halfway through sweeping, Li Qunshu leaned on the broom handle and looked back at Lin Zui, "Brother Zui."
"Huh?"
"Nothing." He turned his head again and continued scanning.
Lin Zui looked at his back and didn't ask any questions.
…
The outer gate is a side courtyard.
Qi Yun stood at the entrance of the courtyard, his hands hanging by his sides and his body slightly arched.
Today he changed into clean outer disciple clothes and his hair was tied up again.
There is a smile on the face, a concrete smile that is not smiling at all.
He stood at the door for about a stick of incense before a voice came from inside the house.
"Come in."
Qi Yun opened the door, and the smile on his face instantly became extremely flattering.
Chu Xiong was leaning on the chair, one foot resting on the tea table, while a woman with a pretty face and plump body massaged him.
Where exactly is the massage place... (If you understand, face the wall and think about it, if you don’t understand, pretend to be)
"Senior Brother Chu," Qi Yun bent down, "I think about what you said last time..."
"Did I let you speak?"
Qi Yun's smile froze on his face, then he immediately closed his mouth and bent even lower.
Chu Xiong perked up for a while and said in a neither salty nor cool tone.
